concerns.text: Task T017a-1 hardcodes scope to 'Fe-Cr ONLY' and raises NotImplementedError for other systems (Ni-Mo, Cu-Zn). This silently narrows FR-003 which mandates generating energies for '[deferred] configurations' (implying multiple systems) without a documented spec amendment or explicit MVP staging clause in the spec itself.

Task T004c implements a citation validator with a hardcoded whitelist ['https://materialsproject.org', '']. This omits the OQMD URL, which is the primary source per Spec/Plan. This violates Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) by failing to validate the primary data source, effectively weakening the data integrity constraint.

Task T032 defines sensitivity analysis thresholds as 'quantiles of descriptor values' (10th, 50th, 90th percentiles). Spec FR-006 requires sweeping 'decision thresholds (e.g., regularization strength)'. Using data distribution quantiles instead of model hyperparameters (lambda/alpha) fails to test the model's decision boundary stability, weakening the FR-006 requirement.

Task T025b implements permutation testing by shuffling the *target variable* (segregation energy). SC-001 requires measuring statistical significance via permutation testing to validate predictive utility. Shuffling the target destroys the physical relationship and tests a null hypothesis of 'no correlation' rather than the specific model significance required by SC-001, weakening the acceptance criterion.
